LESSON: PACKAGED FOOD EDUCATION

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.1: Packaged food Education

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Packaged food Education

• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What information is found packaged foods sold in the empty packages, video clips on the packages?

• Use safe examples only.

• Safe action connected to Packaged food Education.
